# mobile_api/controllers/rewards_controller.rb
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'redis'

module MobileAPI
  class RewardsController < Sinatra::Base
    FEATURE_FLAGS = {
      'loyalty_v2' => true,
      'double_points_promo' => true,
      'points_cap_disabled' => false
    }.freeze

    MAX_POINTS_PER_TXN = 10_000
    POINTS_BALANCE_CAP = 2_147_483_647  # Max safe 32-bit signed integer

    helpers do
      def redis
        @redis ||= Redis.new(url: ENV.fetch('REDIS_URL', 'redis://localhost:6379'))
      end

      def current_user_id
        raw = env['HTTP_X_USER_ID']
        return nil if raw.nil?
        # Only accept a strictly numeric, positive user id. A non-numeric
        # header must not silently coerce to 0 and bypass authentication.
        return nil unless raw.match?(/\A\d+\z/)
        id = raw.to_i
        id.positive? ? id : nil
      end

      def feature_enabled?(flag_name)
        override = redis.get("feature:#{flag_name}:#{current_user_id}")
        return override == 'true' if override
        FEATURE_FLAGS.fetch(flag_name, false)
      end

      def calculate_points(base_amount, multiplier_code)
        multiplier = resolve_multiplier(multiplier_code)
        raw_points = base_amount * multiplier
        apply_points_policy(raw_points)
      end

      def resolve_multiplier(code)
        case code
        when 'standard' then 1
        when 'silver' then 2
        when 'gold' then 3
        when 'platinum' then 5
        when 'promo'
          feature_enabled?('double_points_promo') ? 10 : 5
        else 1
        end
      end

      def apply_points_policy(raw_points)
        capped = if feature_enabled?('points_cap_disabled')
                   raw_points
                 else
                   [raw_points, MAX_POINTS_PER_TXN].min
                 end
        capped
      end

      def credit_points(user_id, points)
        current = redis.get("user:#{user_id}:points").to_i
        new_balance = compute_new_balance(current, points)
        redis.set("user:#{user_id}:points", new_balance)
        { user_id: user_id, credited: points, balance: new_balance }
      end

      def compute_new_balance(current, points_to_add)
        # Use safe arbitrary-precision arithmetic
        # Clamp to balance cap to prevent overflow on mobile clients
        sum = current + points_to_add
        # Clamp to valid range for signed 32-bit mobile clients
        if sum > POINTS_BALANCE_CAP
          POINTS_BALANCE_CAP
        elsif sum < 0
          0
        else
          sum
        end
      end

      def validate_transaction_amount(amount)
        amount.is_a?(Integer) && amount > 0 && amount <= 100_000
      end
    end

    before do
      content_type :json
      halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json unless current_user_id
    end

    post '/api/v1/rewards/earn' do
      payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      amount = payload['transaction_amount'].to_i
      tier = payload['tier_code'] || 'standard'

      unless validate_transaction_amount(amount)
        halt 422, { error: 'invalid transaction amount' }.to_json
      end

      points = calculate_points(amount, tier)
      result = credit_points(current_user_id, points)
      status 200
      result.to_json
    end

    get '/api/v1/rewards/balance' do
      balance = redis.get("user:#{current_user_id}:points").to_i
      { user_id: current_user_id, balance: balance }.to_json
    end

    post '/api/v1/rewards/redeem' do
      payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      points_to_redeem = payload['points'].to_i
      current = redis.get("user:#{current_user_id}:points").to_i

      if points_to_redeem <= 0
        halt 422, { error: 'invalid redemption amount' }.to_json
      end

      if current < points_to_redeem
        halt 422, { error: 'insufficient points' }.to_json
      end

      new_balance = compute_new_balance(current, -points_to_redeem)
      redis.set("user:#{current_user_id}:points", new_balance)
      { user_id: current_user_id, redeemed: points_to_redeem, balance: new_balance }.to_json
    end
  end
end
